name: Visual Translate by Vozo
tagline: Localize video text overlays into any language without rebuilding your visuals.
problem: Businesses expanding into global markets face costly, time-consuming video localization workflows that require redesigning graphics and text overlays from scratch for each language. Visual Translate automates the detection and translation of on-screen text while preserving the original visual design. This eliminates the need for motion designers to manually recreate assets for every language variant.
useCases: Localizing product demo videos for international markets
Translating training and onboarding videos for multilingual workforces
Adapting marketing video campaigns for regional audiences
Converting subtitle and caption overlays across multiple languages at scale
